source: GitHub REST via gh api GET; no logs

methodology.sample: Latest N completed runs in API created-descending order at collection time; an intentional sample, not all repository history.
methodology.cohorts: All completed runs returned for every PR commit SHA. SHA-associated, including push and pull_request events; not an exclusive attribution of cost to a PR. Cohorts overlap: never sum them.
methodology.attempts: Every run attempt fetched separately, jobs deduplicated by job ID within the run. After exhausted transient errors on the attempt-jobs route, the fully paginated generic filter=all route is accepted only with explicit valid matching run_id/run_attempt; other attempts are excluded. Every attempt retains route, fallback and capture provenance. Run count differs from attempt count; reruns are sum(run_attempt - 1).
methodology.quantiles: Sorted finite nonnegative seconds, linear interpolation at (n-1)*q (R type 7). Every distribution reports n and missing; empty quantiles are null.
methodology.allocation: Sum completed_at - started_at for jobs with a positive runner_id and valid UTC timestamps (year >= 2000). No rounding/multipliers. Missing/inverted timestamps are unknown, never zero. This is allocated runner resource time, not money or API billable minutes.
methodology.cancellation: Allocation of all measured jobs in runs whose latest conclusion is cancelled, including their earlier attempts. Separately count cancelled jobs and cancelled runs with no measurable allocation.
methodology.workflow_time: Latest attempt, positive runner_id jobs only: observed elapsed = run_started_at to last completed allocated job; observed job span = first allocated job start to last allocated job completion. Skipped/unallocated synthetic timestamps are excluded. These exclude unobserved completion overhead; updated_at is not a completion timestamp. Mixed workflows are not an L0/L1 KPI.
methodology.queue: Positive runner_id jobs only: job.created_at to started_at where both exist, including dependency/scheduler wait; not pure runner-capacity wait. Skipped/unallocated synthetic zero-delay timestamps are excluded, reported missing. First-job delay = attempt.run_started_at to first allocated job start, not trigger-to-start or rerun queue time.
methodology.critical_path: Only exact push head workflow blobs with static unique job names, no matrix/reusable/dynamic jobs and complete job mapping: longest needs-DAG path weighted by observed job execution seconds. Excludes scheduling gaps, conditions and workflow overhead. Observed span and longest job remain separate. Other cases explicitly unavailable.
methodology.builds: Executed step names matching build/compile (excluding post steps) with valid timestamps; a metadata proxy. Actual compiler rebuilds, Nx/cache hits and repeated deterministic builds cannot be inferred without separate logs/artifacts.
methodology.duplicates: Same head SHA + workflow_id with both push and pull_request events. Lists run IDs; indicates duplicate triggers, not proven redundant validation.
methodology.failure: Failed run/job/step conclusions and names only. Root cause UNKNOWN: metadata cannot prove a product or infrastructure cause. No full logs downloaded.
methodology.readiness: PR creation/ready_for_review event/merge timestamps are lifecycle only. Successful workflow completion after a commit is not proof the required check set was ready. CI-ready/change-to-ready, regression escape and L0/L1 class metrics unavailable without check-set/classification evidence.
methodology.billing: Current public visibility implies no GitHub Actions billable minutes under documented public-repository policy. Historical visibility, paid runner products and invoices are not collected. Private-repo billable minutes and all monetary costs remain unknown. No savings claim.
methodology.boundedness: API pages up to 100, maximum 10 pages per full list, maximum 20 attempts/run and explicit global request/report-size limits. GET requests retry transport/timeouts or HTTP 502/503/504 at most twice with short backoff. Hitting a bound fails collection rather than silently truncating. Workflow-source unavailability is retained explicitly.
